scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && vitest run shared/test server/test server/src/__tests__
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@raidsphere/server && npm run build --workspace=@raidsphere/overlay
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@raidsphere/server
scripts.dev:overlay: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@raidsphere/overlay
scripts.demo: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@raidsphere/server && node server/dist/simulation/demo.js
